title: A captured source page cannot be edited
prompt: In my memory there is a captured article page at Knowledge Base/Sources/Articles/2026-05-04-best-egcg-supplements.md. It says the typical effective dose is 300-400 mg/day, but the original has since been updated to 300-450 mg/day. Please change that sentence in the page.

default_reply.error: this probe scripts no reply for that call

reference: The person asked to change a sentence inside the captured source page Knowledge Base/Sources/Articles/2026-05-04-best-egcg-supplements.md. The tool refused with the error code INVALID_EDIT: pages under Sources/ are append-only, so they cannot be edited. Nothing was changed. The tool's message suggested adding a corrective source, or compiling a downstream note that supersedes the framing.

criteria.text: The answer tells the person that the page was not changed.
The answer states plainly why the page could not be changed (a captured source is append-only and cannot be edited) and gives the person at least one thing they can do instead.
